FjDGNF2Z.content: Marks: columns 4px rounded at the data end, 2px gaps between fills, one y-axis per chart (no dual axes), a legend whenever there are two series.
FjDGNF2Z.name: Marks

component.description: Row in a popover menu. Icon set per instance.

Th9VwkdB.content: Two categorical series, in this order everywhere: engines get the same colour on every chart. Status colours only mean a limit state and always ship with an icon and label. Grid and axes stay recessive. Left half light, right half dark.
Th9VwkdB.name: Body

UzBpZXJr.content: Desktop uses the mobile tokens unchanged (apps/mobile/src/tokens.css, via lamsa.config.json). The colour palette and type scale boards live in qiraa-components.lamsa.json. The desktop renderer should import the same CSS instead of its own theme.ts.
UzBpZXJr.name: Body

component.description: Usage against a limit. Ticks mark the warn (70%) and danger (90%) thresholds; set the fill width per instance. Always pair with a Badge (icon + label) so status is never color alone.
Column heading for data tables. Numeric columns align right (set justify-content on the instance).
Sidebar destination. Icon and label set per instance; count is an optional badge (e.g. failed pages).

mNu5xbdb.css:
transition: background 120ms ease-out, color 120ms ease-out;
&:hover { background: {color.surface-2}; color: {color.ink}; }
mNu5xbdb.name: NavItem

component.description: Chart hover readout: a title (the x value) and one line per series. Text stays in ink tokens; the swatch carries identity.
A single headline number with a label and a one-line note (comparison, limit, or context). Not a chart: use it when one number is the answer.
